description: Implementation of BN_CTX functions for big number context management in OpenSSL, including memory allocation, initialization, cleanup, and stack management functions.

methods.name: BN_CTX_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new BN_CTX structure.

methods.name: BN_CTX_free
methods.description: Frees a BN_CTX structure and its resources.

methods.name: BN_CTX_start
methods.description: Marks the start of a new temporary context scope.

methods.name: BN_CTX_get
methods.description: Retrieves a BIGNUM from the context stack.

methods.name: BN_CTX_end
methods.description: Ends the current temporary context scope.
